tags.chapter_name: General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Metals

question.text:
Among following compounds, the number of those present in copper matte is

A. CuCO3

B. Cu2S

C. Cu2O

D. FeO

solution.text: Copper Matte is a combination of copper sulphide and a small amount of iron sulphide. In the process of copper extraction, Matte is the stage after the final reduction process which involves converting it to crude copper.
